build_system: Vite with React plugin, Tailwind CSS
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run build' successfully with no errors. Manual verification of features.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Node.js v22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: Single-file React app in src/App.jsx. All changes go there.
key_patterns: Single monolithic App.jsx (~4673 lines). Uses React hooks extensively. Canvas uses pointer events for drag/pan/zoom. Connection ports appear on hover using 'group-hover:opacity-100'. Edges rendered as SVG paths inside an absolutely positioned <svg> element. Groups are rendered as div elements with border-dashed styling. The getConnectionPoint function resolves edge endpoints for nodes and images. handleLogoTap with ref counting opens the project panel. Keyboard shortcuts use useEffect with window.addEventListener('keydown'...).
directory_structure: src/App.jsx - main app component (4673 lines), src/MiniMap.jsx - minimap component, src/index.css - tailwind styles, src/main.jsx - entry point
